verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an agent payments and identity platform, so pushing order or payment lifecycle events to subscribers is a fair axis for it. The evidence documents only pull-style APIs: token creation, charge, introspection, and wallet balance. Nothing shows registrable webhooks or pushed event subscriptions for created, updated, fulfilled, or canceled events.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent or backend can subscribe to order lifecycle events — created, updated, fulfilled, canceled — pushed programmatically
